abstract: This document is a short excerpt from the BIO 130 Course Handbook with three sections. Section 1 states that plagiarism, unauthorized collaboration, and AI-generated submissions without disclosure result in a zero on the assignment and a referral. Section 2 sets the late work penalty at 10 percent per day, capped at three days. Section 3 directs students to notify the instructor and the Office of Disability Services during week 1 to arrange accommodations.
headline: BIO 130 course handbook excerpt covering academic integrity penalties, late work policy, and accommodation notification steps.
key_points: Plagiarism, unauthorized collaboration, and undisclosed AI-generated submissions result in a zero on the assignment and a referral.
Late work is penalized at 10 percent per day.
The late work penalty applies for a maximum of three days.
Students needing accommodations must notify the instructor and the Office of Disability Services in week 1.
